NAME:

USAGE:
   cloud-nuke aws [command options] [arguments...]

OPTIONS:
   --config value                 YAML file specifying matching rules.
   --delete-unaliased-kms-keys    Delete KMS keys that do not have aliases associated with them. (default: false)
   --dry-run                      Dry run without taking any action. (default: false)

   --force                        Skip nuke confirmation prompt. WARNING: this will automatically delete all targeted resources without any confirmation. (default: false)
   --include-tag value            Only include resources with this tag (format: key=value). Key matching is exact (case-sensitive).    --list-resource-types          List available resource types (default: false)
   --log-level value              Set log level (default: "info") [$LOG_LEVEL]

   --output-file value            Write output to file instead of stdout (optional)
   --output-format value          Output format (table, json) (default: "table")
   --parallelism value            Number of regions/resources to scan and delete concurrently. The work is IO-bound, so this is independent of CPU count. (default: 10)
   --region value                 Regions to include. Include multiple times if more than one.      (accepts multiple inputs)
   --resource-type value          Resource types to nuke. Include multiple times if more than one.  (accepts multiple inputs)
   --timeout value                Resource execution timeout.
